title: Emmy Noether: Modern LaTeX Drafts and English Translation Working Drafts
version: 2026-06-01 Noether record: Paper 02 Spanish/Japanese pilot chunk
description:
Dedicated Emmy Noether record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. The top-level PDFs expose source-checkable German modern LaTeX, English high-fidelity translations, and current multilingual pilot translations.

Status at a glance. [##########] numbered-paper German/English stream: Papers 1-43 complete and audited; [##--------] multilingual stream: Paper 01 pilots in Spanish, Japanese, and French, and Paper 02 through sections before 7 in Spanish and Japanese; [##########] source/artifact preservation: TeX, source-scan witnesses, audit notes, and glossary deltas are preserved in ZIP artifacts.

Latest update. Added Spanish and Japanese Paper 02 pilot translations through the sections before 7, with cumulative Spanish/Japanese readers through this point.
